[driver]

[game]

# Versions the driver was checked against; older saves are read with a warning.
tested-versions = ["1.5.12620"]

# Free content packs, added by updates: each can be left out of the count.
[[dlc]]
id = "hidden-dreams"
name = "Hidden Dreams"
free = true

[[dlc]]

name = "The Grimm Troupe"
free = true

[[dlc]]
id = "lifeblood"
name = "Lifeblood"
free = true

[[dlc]]
id = "godmaster"
name = "Godmaster"
free = true

# entry is also looked up inside the game's Proton prefix.
[[locations]]
platform = "windows"
path = "{localLow}/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight"

[[locations]]
platform = "macos"
path = "{home}/Library/Application Support/unity.Team Cherry.Hollow Knight"

[[locations]]
platform = "linux"
path = "{xdgConfig}/unity3d/Team Cherry/Hollow Knight"

[slots]
kind = "file"
pattern = '^user(?<slot>[1-4])\.dat$'
label = "Slot {slot}"

# The world map, drawn by Hundo from the installed game's own files.
[[maps]]
id = "hallownest"
kind = "unity-sprite-map"
file = "hollow_knight_Data/resources.assets"
root = "Game_Map"
skip = ["Dream_Gate_Pin", "Compass Icon", "Shade Pos", "Flame Pins", "Map Markers"]
skip-prefixes = ["Map_Arrow", "Map Arrow", "Shade", "pop_up"]
# Every pin the game can show: grubs, benches, stags, roots, shops…

rough-suffix = "_Cornifer"

# The game's own names for things (the Hunter's Journal), read from the
# installed game in the reader's language; the driver decrypts them.

file = "hollow_knight_Data/resources.assets"

modules.manifest:
api = 3

[driver]
id = "nine-sols"
name = "Nine Sols"
version = "0.1.0-alpha"
authors = ["Arnaud Michel"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "Jades, seals, skills, arrows, root nodes, items and the database, named as the game names them."

[game]
steam-app-id = 1809540
tested-versions = []
# The save is rolled back after the credits; the account remembers the end.
reads-achievements = true

# A Windows game: on Linux, Hundo looks inside its Proton prefix.
[[locations]]
platform = "windows"
path = "{localLow}/RedCandleGames/NineSols"

# One folder per slot; the game also keeps a copy from before the point of no
# return, `saveslotN_BeforeNoReturnPoint`, which is not a slot of its own.
[slots]
kind = "file"
pattern = '^saveslot(?<slot>[0-9]+)/flags\.sav$'
label = "Slot {slot}"

# Each thing's picture: the game's own sprite. The inventory's are in the
# Addressables bundle, named by a hash that changes with the game's builds.
[images]
files = [
    "NineSols_Data/data.unity3d#resources.assets",
    "NineSols_Data/StreamingAssets/aa/StandaloneWindows64/defaultlocalgroup_assets_all_*.bundle",
]

# The map: the game's own world map, a block per area tinted by its zone, drawn
# from the installed game. The layout (which sprite goes where) is made by
# tools/extract.py; the pictures stay in the reader's copy of the game.
[[maps]]
id = "new-kunlun"
kind = "unity-sprite-collage"
files = ["NineSols_Data/data.unity3d#resources.assets"]
layout = "assets/map-layout.json"
# The panel's own size: its sprites are drawn one texel per pixel.
max-side = 4800
